message: The other day, I was in the kitchen juggling dinner prep and a phone call when I heard our smoke alarm chirp. I thought, "Oh no, not now!" But then I remembered I had just changed the batteries last month. Instead of a full-blown panic, I just had to give it a little tap, and peace returned. 🕊️ It was such a small win, but it reminded me how keeping up with simple tasks can really save the day! Have you checked your alarms lately?
